known.summary: The verify hint in ci-background-task.mjs still names `node --test scripts/tests/unit/ci-background-task.test.mjs`, but this branch runs the unit files with `bun test`, so the hint runs the suite on a runtime the gate no longer uses for it.
The half-scope guard asserts only that the advice does not match `bun scripts/ci.mjs --plugin`, so advice that printed the Node spelling `node scripts/ci.mjs --plugin ...` would still pass the test.
